Three of the contracts have arbitration clauses: Acme_MSA.pdf (§14.2), Brightline_SOW.docx (§9), and Northwind_NDA.pdf (§11).

Vendor_Agreement_2019.pdf is a scanned image with no extractable text, so I couldn't search it, and it may also contain one. The other eight files don't mention arbitration. Running OCR on the vendor agreement would make it searchable.
